projects.title: NASA: High Aspect Ratio Wing (HARW)
projects.description:
Project Description:
The aim of this project was to investigate the impact of novel N+3 technologies on the fuel-burn performance of commercial aircraft. Several of these technologies directly affect the structural weight and aeroelastic performance of these aircraft. Therefore, we were tasked to build conceptual models to capture these impacts.

Involved in the following tasks
• Developed an M&S environment to automate the aeroelastic analysis of a parametric, high aspect ratio wing via MSC Nastran
• Developed a parametric, linear-static, finite element model to structurally analyze the HARW wing
• Created surrogate models for the wing-weight of the HARW as a function of common wing design parameters

projects.title: NASA: Truss-Braced Wing Study For A Regional Jet And A Small Twin Aisle Aircraft Concept
projects.description: Investigated the impact of structural weight on the fuel burn performance of truss-braced wing variants of a regional jet and a small twin aisle aircraft.
